verdict.rationale: Pika is a SaaS creative platform, so a telemetry and usage-tracking opt-out is a fair question to ask of it. Nothing in the evidence pack mentions telemetry, analytics, tracking controls, or any privacy opt-out setting. The cited items cover creative features, pricing, sign-in methods, the API and MCP, none of which address this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
